abstract.text: Learn how LinkMap organizes shared places and work, use the iOS and web apps, and understand the implementation behind them.

inlineContent.text: Start with Essentials for the common model. The handbooks contain platform-specific guidance. Shared Concepts explains the data and collaboration boundaries used by both platforms. Reference contains a small, curated set of Swift model declarations.

abstract.text: LinkMap centers on a Project: a shared map and a collection of Activities. Places remain available across Activities, so a team can plan another round of work without recreating its map.
Use the iOS handbook to create and manage work in the native app. Use the web handbook to explore Projects and Locations in a browser and to understand the website implementation.
This section selects a few Swift models whose declarations clarify the Project and resource model. It is a curated reference, not a complete export of the app target’s internal symbols.
Both platforms refer to the same Project and Location data. The iOS app manages the full workflow; the web map reads the Project and places available to the signed-in account.
